record.original_question: Fix k >= 3 and write m + k(k+1)/2 == l mod k with 1 <= l <= k - 1. Which graph in G(m, theta_{1,2,2k-1}) union G(m, theta_{1,2,2k}) has the largest spectral radius?

evidence.quote: Problem 7 (Liu et al. [27], 2026). For k >= 3, when m + k(k+1)/2 == l (mod k) with 1 <= l <= k - 1, which graphs in G(m, theta1,2,2k-1) union G(m, theta1,2,2k), achieve the largest spectral radius?
By employing k-core analysis combined with spectral techniques, Liu et al. [27] overcomed Problem 7 as follows.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let θ_{a,b,c} denote the theta graph obtained by joining two distinct vertices by three internally vertex-disjoint paths of lengths a, b, c (with a ≤ b ≤ c and b ≥ 2). For a graph H, let G(m, H) denote the set of all simple graphs with exactly m edges that contain no copy of H as a subgraph. The spectral radius of a simple graph G is the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix.

Fix an integer k ≥ 3, and write m + k(k+1)/2 ≡ ℓ (mod k) with 1 ≤ ℓ ≤ k − 1. Determine, for all sufficiently large m, the graph(s) in 

  G(m, θ_{1,2,2k−1}) ∪ G(m, θ_{1,2,2k})

that attain the largest spectral radius.
artifact.category_tag: spectral graph theory / forbidden theta subgraphs
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Li, Zhao and Zou, and related results extended by Liu et al.) has resolved this Brualdi–Hoffman–Turán-type problem: for k ≥ 3 and m sufficiently large, the unique extremal graph in G(m, θ_{1,2,2k−1}) ∪ G(m, θ_{1,2,2k}) is K_k ∨ ((m/k − (k−1)/2)K_1) when k | (m + k(k+1)/2), with explicit characterizations for the other residue classes ℓ via k-core analysis combined with spectral techniques.

status_evidence.title: Spectral extrema of graphs with fixed size: forbidden a fan graph, friendship graph or theta graph
status_evidence.snippet: For k ≥ 3 and m sufficiently large, if G ∈ G(m, θ_{1,2,2k−1}) ∪ G(m, θ_{1,2,2k}) attains the maximum spectral radius, then G is characterized explicitly (e.g. K_k ∨ tK_1 in the divisible case).
status_evidence.claim: The extremal graph attaining the largest spectral radius in this class is determined for sufficiently large m.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Extrema of Graphs With Fixed Size: Forbidden a Fan Graph, a Friendship Graph, or a Theta Graph
status_evidence.snippet: Published version (J. Graph Theory, 2025) characterizing extremal spectral-radius graphs avoiding theta graphs of given size.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication confirming resolution of the spectral-radius extremal problem for θ_{1,2,2k−1}/θ_{1,2,2k}-free graphs.
